integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. The bundled exact-arithmetic finite checks are corroborative only and are not treated as exhaustive evidence for the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact common real overlap \(0<s<1\), uniform ordered injective tuples, and exact unambiguous discrimination only. The minimum-error half of the motivating conjecture is not addressed.
title: Exact unambiguous discrimination for equal-overlap injective quantum sequences
